extraction.Name: Thomas Hand
extraction.Recorded patent: Was it filed for record? no
extraction.Buyer: Land sold for $1664.80 to Bill Perry, who was employed at Pawnee Indian Agency
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: Has any of the land been sold for debt or taxes? no
extraction.Occupation/Income: No inherited land, only income of allottee is Pawnee Annuity
extraction.NOTES: Good health, no money or property accumulated; seven children dependent on allottee for support; patent delivered August 2, 1917, by mail; receipted for: yes; allottee states that he wanted $60 per acre for his land, but had to sell for $40.00 per acre; mortgage: no; document notarized November 26, 1928, in Pawnee County, State of Oklahoma; commission expires Aug. 31, 1929; file reference 61391
